# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, yeah — I need a little rescue mission for an order.

I’m Noah Patel. I had this whole brilliant plan: go back to my parents’ place in Seattle, work remotely, become one with nature, buy some home office stuff plus some hiking gear… very “balanced lifestyle,” you know? And now my company has decided, surprise, I’m heading back to the office soon, so my master plan has collapsed a bit.

So I wanted to see if it’s possible to cancel or return just part of the order — specifically the home office items — and keep the hiking stuff. I honestly forgot exactly which items those office ones were, but there were three of them in the order.

If that partial cancellation/return is possible, can you tell me how much I’d get refunded in total? And I’d want that refund to go back to my original payment method.

If partial cancellation isn’t possible, then can we just change the shipping address to my NYC place instead, and I’ll deal with returning the office items later? I’m in New York, zip code 10108.

So yeah, either:
1. cancel/remove the office items and tell me the refund amount, original payment method please, or
2. if that can’t be done, change the address to my NYC address.

Thanks — my anxiety and I appreciate it.
noah_patel_6952

Please tell me which order ID you want help with.

Once you send that, I can check:
- whether it’s still pending or already delivered
- whether partial cancellation or return is possible
- which 3 items are the home office items
- the refund total
- and, if needed, update the shipping address instead

If you don’t know the order ID, I can help you identify it from the order details.

Thanks — and wow, past me really was busy shopping like I was building a second life.

I don’t know the order ID off the top of my head. Can you help me identify it from the order details instead?

It should be the one with 3 home office items and some hiking items together in the same order — basically “corporate despair meets outdoorsy optimism.”
